items.item_text: This position will be required to complete all pre-employment requirements, including a background investigation, the University's credentialing process, and verification of licensure and/or certification through the appropriate California licensing or certifying board(s), as applicable.
Bachelor’s degree in education, higher education, social sciences, counseling, or related field and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience working with historically underserved, underrepresented, first-generation, or low-income student populations.
Experience working in higher education, student affairs, student services, or community-based organizations.  (Preferred)
Experience supporting student programs, workshops, educational initiatives, or student engagement activities.
Experience supporting student engagement initiatives, outreach, or program coordination. (Preferred)
Experience working collaboratively with campus and community partners. (Preferred)
Student Support & Resource Navigation

Provides individualized support and resource navigation to undocumented, mixed-status, first generation, low-income, and historically underserved student populations. Assists students in accessing campus and community resources related to academic success, financial support, legal services, wellness, and basic needs. Conducts follow-up communication with students to support engagement and connection to appropriate services. Assists students in identifying barriers to success and promotes self-advocacy and problem-solving skills.
Program Support & Student Engagement

Assists with planning and implementation of Monarch Center programs, workshops, and student engagement activities. Supports educational programming and community-building opportunities that promote belonging, leadership development, and student success. Assists with student outreach, communications, and promotional efforts to increase awareness and participation in Monarch Center programs and services. Supports collaboration efforts with campus departments and community partners related to student programming and referrals.
Operational Support & Event Coordination
Provides operational support for Monarch Center programs and student-facing services.

Assists with logistical coordination for programs and events, including supply preparation, scheduling support, room reservations, and implementation needs. Supports front-facing student engagement and assists with responding to student inquiries. Maintains organized program materials, student participation records, and resource information.
Program Tracking & Documentation

Assists with tracking student participation, program attendance, and engagement data. Supports collection and organization of program feedback and participation information. Assists with maintaining records and documentation related to Monarch Center activities and services.
Assists with communication and coordination related to student staff, fellows, interns, and volunteers.
Supports administrative processes including purchasing documentation, reimbursement support, and other program-related operational needs. Performs other related duties as assigned.
Bachelor’s degree in related field from an accredited institution

5 years of progressively responsible experience working with students, in higher education, or within student affairs/student services or with a community based organization would be accepted in lieu of a bachelors degree.
1 year of progressively responsible experience working with students, in higher education, or within student affairs/student services or with a community based organization.
Familiarity with undocumented student services, equity-centered student support, and/or student retention efforts. (Preferred)
Background check  required.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality when working with sensitive student information.
